author: nflaig
content: 2 is not a lodestar bug, it's related to our api allowing skipping checks, but that's intentional, if builder and proposer share the same bn it possible to include bids that don't follow the proposer preferences, but if they are the same enitity (which will not be the case on mainnet) this is fine, we removed adding bids via api to our pool now, seems only relevant for kurtosis testing

author: nflaig
content: for 3, this seems fine to me, we should not reject a CL block due to this, however, a proposer should also not include such a bid in the block since we have `is_gas_limit_target_compatible` and such a gas limit can never pass this check, so it might be the same issue as 2
